summary: Frontend end-to-end testing of Farm2Home. Landing, login (customer/farmer/admin quick buttons), registration testids, product detail, cart, wishlist, checkout with UPI (order created and visible on /orders), AI Hub (predictions + streaming chat + recommendations), farmer product creation, admin dashboard stats and lists, language selector, and logout+redirect all working. One critical page crash reproduced on direct navigation to /product/:id when products context is empty.

ui_bugs.issue: Crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading minOrderQty)' when navigating directly to /product/:id if products list is still loading (products[0] is undefined). Reproducible by opening /product/p1 in a fresh tab/hard refresh. Home page click works because products are already fetched.
Farmer rows have no data-testid (e.g., verify-farmer-<id>). Testability gap; UI itself renders 6 farmers correctly.
Order rows have no data-testid (e.g., recent-order-<id>). Testability gap; UI shows 9 orders.
Wishlist items are rendered but do not carry the product-card-<id> data-testid used elsewhere. Only nav-wishlist-link testid found on the page.
Sub-caption reads 'X customers' underneath 'VERIFIED FARMERS' count, which is confusing (mixing farmer count with customer count label).

issues: Verified Farmers card subtitle labels the number as 'customers' - misleading copy

action_items: Fix ProductDetailPage to guard against empty products (e.g., show loader while products.length===0 or fetch product by id via API) and avoid product[0] fallback that breaks when array is empty.
Add data-testid to admin farmer verification rows (verify-farmer-<id>) and recent order rows (recent-order-<id>) for reliable automation.
Add product-card-<id> data-testid to wishlist items to match the pattern used elsewhere.
Clarify stat-farmers subtitle copy on admin dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetailPage line 12 uses `products.find(...) || products[0]` which throws if products is empty; treat undefined product as loading/not-found state.
Multiple 401s on initial anonymous load from /api/auth/me are noisy in console - consider suppressing or handling silently.
Language selector is visual-only (values 'Tamil'/'Hindi'); no i18n wiring - acceptable per PRD but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (12/13 flows pass; product-detail direct-nav crash is the main defect)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All quick-login buttons work but they only pre-fill the form; the tester must still click login-submit. ProductDetailPage /product/:id direct-load crashes on empty products array; use Home page click flow (via inner cursor-pointer div) to open detail page reliably in tests. Language selector option values are 'English'/'Tamil'/'Hindi' (not 'en'/'ta'/'hi').
rca_of_the_issue: ProductDetailPage.jsx uses `const product = products.find(p => p.id === id) || products[0]` at line 12. When the route mounts before AppContext finishes loading /api/products, `products` is [], so `product` becomes undefined. Subsequent access `product.minOrderQty` (line 13) and `product.farmerName` (line 19) throw. Fix: show a loading skeleton while `products.length === 0`, or fetch the product from /api/products/:id directly, and render a 404 UI if not found. Do not fall back to products[0].
